source.dataset: NIH NLM NCBI PubMed Central Article Datasets — Open Access Subset
source.source_scope: English MEDLINE-indexed biomedical and life-sciences journal articles; any resulting claim is restricted to this domain

amendment_reason: Q10-SOURCE-003's six attempted searches returned zero IDs because ESearch treated the explicit AND NOT clauses as positive terms. The PMC User Guide requires uppercase Boolean operators and documents grouping; the NIH Preprint Pilot FAQ demonstrates a positive search followed by NOT preprint[filter] and states that E-utilities requires a search term before Boolean NOT. This new attempt groups all positive terms first and places one grouped NOT clause afterward. It preserves the 48-candidate sample, filters, strata, rights rules, dates and size caps; it does not reuse the empty Q10-SOURCE-003 result lists.

query_protocol.positive_base_query: open access[filter] AND cc by license[filter] AND english[la] AND 2018:2025[dp]
query_protocol.topic_field_note: The frozen [mh] MeSH topic terms restrict retrieval to the MEDLINE-indexed subset of PMC.
query_protocol.query_translation_gate: Before proceeding to another stratum or selecting IDs, inspect the ESearch query_translation and query_warnings. The translation must preserve a final Boolean NOT clause containing both the author-manuscript and preprint filters, combined with OR. If it omits or changes that exclusion, or the warning output contains a standalone NOT term, stop, record the syntax failure, and do not select candidates or request per-version metadata.
query_protocol.ordering: Run each of the six frozen queries once with retmax=1000 after its translation passes the syntax gate. Sort each returned numeric PMCID list ascending; process strata in the listed order; take the first eight globally unique IDs for each stratum. Skip IDs already assigned to an earlier stratum and continue through that stratum's frozen result list. Do not replace a candidate after metadata screening. If fewer than 48 unique candidates are available across the six capped result lists, the candidate-selection gate fails.
query_protocol.query_result_sha256_encoding: UTF-8 of the exact numeric ID strings in original API order joined by comma, no trailing comma
query_protocol.candidate_selection_sha256_encoding: UTF-8 of one line per selected candidate in selection order as stratum_name<TAB>PMCID, LF separated, no trailing LF

screening_protocol.version_source: For the 48 frozen PMCID candidates only, inspect PMC Cloud per-version JSON metadata, exact S3 XML object-list metadata, and OAI-PMH compact Dublin Core (metadataPrefix=oai_dc). Do not request full-text or pmc_fm records. Process only identifier, title, creator, date, subject/citation and rights fields; do not retain dc:description containing abstract text. Require exactly one available Cloud article version per PMCID.
version_eligibility: the raw license_code maps to the CC BY family and agrees with the PMC cc by license search filter

at least one OAI-PMH oai_dc dc:rights value is exactly https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/; record every rights value and fail if another value gives a different CC license URI or conflicting restriction
the exact XML object is present and its MD5, S3 LastModifiedDate, version and byte size are recorded
the exact XML object is at most 1 MiB
Cloud citation publication year and all available OAI dc:date values resolve consistently to 2018 through 2025
title, creator list, DOI and source citation are present and unambiguous
article_metadata_exclusions: records with a missing or ambiguous version, rights statement, title, author list, DOI, or source citation
records whose Cloud citation year or available OAI dc:date does not resolve consistently to 2018 through 2025
records with conflicting license or restriction metadata

bounds.combined_xml_size_applies_to: all metadata-eligible versions in the frozen 48-PMCID set; if their sum exceeds the cap, do not request any article XML

acquisition_gate.body_request_allowed_only_if: all 48 candidate records are screened, at least 20 versions pass, and the sum of all eligible XML object sizes is at most 4194304 bytes
acquisition_gate.after_xml_gate: Retrieve eligible XML serially through an approved PMC service; inspect article-level rights and exclude separately licensed or untraceable content before deterministic preparation.

selection_inventory_sha256_encoding: UTF-8 of one line per selected candidate in selection order as stratum_name<TAB>PMCID, LF separated, no trailing LF
